consolidation.summary: Fourth pass on commit 4a214dd3. Reviewer 3's exact finding (a handler that reads a decoy spine directly and returns its content without ever calling the engine) is genuinely resolved -- reproduced RED on test_no_argument_can_change_what_the_door_reads_or_where_it_reads_it. triage_candidates.statement: The pass-through pin (test_no_argument_can_change_what_the_door_reads_or_where_it_reads_it) checks the engine-called branch with a substring test (assertIn sentinel in text), not equality against the engine call's own output. A handler that calls run_engine genuinely and then concatenates content read from an attacker-named path onto the result stays fully green, because the sentinel survives the concatenation. Demonstrated live on spine_status via an undeclared key whose value names a decoy spine file; the leaked JSON appears in the response alongside the real engine output, isError False. Fix: assert the text equals the engine call's own captured stdout plus stderr exactly (or at least does not exceed it), not merely that it contains the sentinel.
